meta.title: Personal Memory
meta.description: Personal Memory panel: today, what you know (personal), and the days you lived (memory) — read, search, edit.

config.baseId: Knowledge base to search; empty means every base
config.mode: Retrieval mode: hybrid, vector or lexical
config.maxQueryChars: Longest prompt prefix sent to retrieval
config.perSessionDocLimit: Most notes injected in one session
config.panelTopK: Hits per search in the panel
config.workspace: Workspace root; empty means auto-detect the folder with personal/ and memory/
config.quickNote: Enable the quick-note button (appends to today's diary)
config.autoReindex: Rebuild the index after a quick note
